tools.name: list_miami_businesses
tools.description: List Miami44's business sites, optionally narrowed by words, neighborhood (for example 'Wynwood') or category (for example 'restaurant'). Returns each business's name, link name (slug), site URL, category, neighborhood and whether a verified owner runs it. The reply gives total, has_more and next_of

tools.name: find_miami_business
tools.description: Search Miami44's business sites by name. Returns each match's name, link name (slug) and site URL.

tools.name: get_business_site
tools.description: Read one Miami business's site as plain text: what it is, where it is, what visitors can do with its official links, whether a verified owner runs it, and its sources. Details are public information and may be out of date.
